provider: Illustrative mapping prepared by the gateway operator, Andrei Besleaga, from the reporting subject's own published digital-estate emissions file in its own DIST format (dist.json, self-reported); NOT published, reviewed, authorized, or endorsed by the reporting subject. Every figure is read from the source document named in methodology-uri. Scope caveats: DIGITAL ESTATE ONLY (the organization's technology footprint by Technology Carbon Standard category), not a full organizational inventory. carbon-footprint is the SUM of the entries of the source file, which states no total; one entry (upstream employee hardware, 186 kgCO2e) appears twice in the file and is counted once, which gives the 496 kgCO2e total printed on the method pages the file itself cites. The SaaS category carries no value in the source (reliable data not available) and is therefore not part of the figure. GHG Protocol scopes, an accounting basis and an energy figure are not published and are omitted.
